title: SETTLEMENT — three preregistered confirmatory tests, one shot each
locked_before: any execution of p11_*/p12_*/p13_*/p14_* analysis code on real data
provenance_of_every_frozen_choice: Phase-1/2/3 artifacts ONLY. No Phase-4 number exists at lock time. Where a frozen choice is in tension with prior-phase evidence, the tension is DISCLOSED below rather than resolved in the design's favour.

hard_rules_inherited.gpus: 4,5,6,7 only; idle <=> mem < 1000 MiB AND util < 10%, re-verified immediately before EVERY launch; else sleep 300 s and re-check
hard_rules_inherited.readers: marker-gated atomic reads (phase4/src/p4lib.py, a copy of phase3/src/p3lib.py). NEVER existence-only.
hard_rules_inherited.frozen_configs: configs/policy.yaml (BC) and phase3/results/p10_config_frozen.json (diffusion) are NOT retuned
hard_rules_inherited.writes: only under phase4/; Phase-1/2/3 artifacts are READ-ONLY
hard_rules_inherited.arithmetic: exact rational arithmetic (fractions.Fraction) for every criterion comparison (ratio >= 1/2)
hard_rules_inherited.determinism_gate: any new rollout determinism check must run on a DISCRIMINATING checkpoint (Phase-3 incident 3: a near-floor model passes trivially)
hard_rules_inherited.no_fabrication: every reported number read from an artifact file; SYNTHETIC tests labelled and never mixed
hard_rules_inherited.defects: any defect goes to phase4/PHASE4_DEFECT.md BEFORE anything is touched
hard_rules_inherited.no_post_hoc: ZERO post-hoc criterion changes. If a preregistered gate fails, the stage REPORTS and STOPS.

shared_definitions.outcome_primary: neg_plain_loss = -(held-out executed-action L2) on the target cluster's 10 held-out demos
shared_definitions.demo_predictor: predicted_mask_score(M) = sum over d in M of score_d (src/lds.py:mask_pred_score)
shared_definitions.coarse_predictor_grain_g: group_score(G) = sum_{d in G} score_d ; predicted_mask_score(M) = sum_G group_score(G) * |G ∩ M| / g  (phase3/src/p7_grain_ladder.py:coarse_pred). At g=1 this is EXACTLY the demo predictor.
shared_definitions.per_member_scale_normalization: each ensemble member's 135-demo score vector is divided by its own L2 norm (-> unit L2 norm) BEFORE averaging over members. Rank-invariant to any per-member positive rescaling.
shared_definitions.ratio_to_ceiling: rho / measured_ceiling; the bar is ratio >= 1/2, compared with exact rational arithmetic

P11.name: CHAMPION CONFIRMATORY TEST ON THE BC-TRANSFORMER
P11.rationale: Phases 2-3 never tested the configuration their own evidence says is best. The champion is frozen HERE, from prior-phase evidence only.

champion_estimator.ensemble: E = 20 full-corpus BC members: ens_s201..ens_s210 (Phase-1 Stage E, results/influence_table_per_member.parquet) + ens_s211..ens_s220 (Phase-3 P9, phase3/results/p9_influence_new_members.parquet)
champion_estimator.per_member_definition: TracIn = sum over that member's 5 checkpoints of eta_c * <g_demo(theta_c), g_target(theta_c)> (src/attribution.py) — UNCHANGED
champion_estimator.aggregation: per-member scale normalization (unit L2) then MEAN over the 20 members
justification_on_record: TracIn is the ONLY reproducible attributor: per-demo rank split-half reliability 0.831 at E=20 vs IF 0.254 (Phase-3 P9, p9_ensemble_cost_law.json); ~16 members suffice for r=0.8 vs ~235 for IF.
Per-member scale normalization is what the lambda->inf analysis showed matters: 0.504 (normalized) vs 0.397 (unnormalized) on C1 (Phase-3 P6.5, p6_lambda_sweep_extended.json).
NEITHER fact was derived from the statistic this test computes (both are properties of the ATTRIBUTOR's internal reproducibility / of an E=10 sweep, not of the E=20 normalized-TracIn LDS at S=10).

secondary_estimator.definition: the exact lambda->infinity limit estimator: the RAW gradient dot product K_m[i,j] = <g_demo_i, g_target_j> per member, per-member scale-normalized (unit L2) and averaged over the SAME E=20 members
secondary_estimator.inputs_not_yet_on_disk: K_m for members 211-220 (phase3/results/p6_gram_cache.npz holds G,K for members 201-210 only). Phase 4 extends the cache with ONE gradient pass over the 10 new members (~0.5-1 GPU-h, 0 retrains). The probe-leak guard runs on every member first.

descriptive_only_variants: GradDot_E20_dmean: the P6.5 form K_m / mean(diag(G_m)) averaged over members (the literal lambda->inf limit of the ensemble-MEAN score). Reported DESCRIPTIVELY; it is NOT part of any confirmatory family.
IF and TRAK at E=20, normalized and unnormalized: DESCRIPTIVE.
unnormalized TracIn at E=20: DESCRIPTIVE (the contrast that isolates the normalization).

ground_truth.seed_count: the DEEPEST available: S=10 (seeds 401-410) if P12 completes; else S=6 (seeds 401-406). The analysis seed count is recorded in the verdict artifact.
ground_truth.aggregator_justification: the BC-Transformer's executed-action outcome is NOT heavy-tailed. Phase-2's Spearman-Brown consistency check on this exact instrument agreed to 0.014 (predicted 0.947 vs measured 0.933, PHASE2_REPORT / p1_demo_grain.json). This is the preregistered justification and it predates any Phase-4 number.
ground_truth.ceiling_S10: mean Spearman over ALL 126 distinct 5-vs-5 seed split-halves of the 10 seeds, between the two half-MEAN outcome vectors across the 24 masks; then Spearman-Brown corrected x2 (5 -> 10). If P12 falls back to S=8, the ceiling is all 35 distinct 4v4 splits, SB x2.
ground_truth.ceiling_S6_fallback: the Phase-2 P1 estimator verbatim (10 distinct 3v3 splits, SB x2)

CRITERION.test: champion rho >= 0.5 * measured ceiling at the analysis seed count AND one-sided p < 0.025 (Bonferroni-2 across the two focal targets)
CRITERION.form: any-focal-target: PASS if the criterion is met on C1 OR C5
CRITERION.secondary_family: the secondary estimator is judged on the same two targets at Bonferroni-4 (p < 0.0125)
CRITERION.all_9_targets: reported DESCRIPTIVELY, never as a verdict

PREREGISTERED_SYMMETRIC_INTERPRETATION.PASS_on_at_least_one_focal_target: a stability-selected, normalization-corrected attributor IS demo-grain faithful where default-config attribution was not — the Phase-2/3 null is a statement about attribution AS PRACTICED, not about attribution's ceiling.
PREREGISTERED_SYMMETRIC_INTERPRETATION.FAIL_on_both: the null now covers the best configuration the evidence could assemble — champion-tested, not just default-tested.

P11.ordering_constraint: P11's verdict is computed AFTER P12 completes (its prereg names S=10 primary). The P11 analysis code is not run on real data before this preregistration is hashed.

P12.name: DEEPEN THE BC GROUND TRUTH TO S=10
P12.design: the EXISTING 24 Stage-G demo masks x 4 NEW seeds (407, 408, 409, 410), combined with the existing seeds 401-406 -> S = 10. Identical config (configs/policy.yaml), identical trainer (src/train.py), identical probe battery (27 tasks x 10 rollouts => 30 episodes per cluster target).
P12.new_ceilings: all 126 distinct 5v5 split-halves of the 10 seeds (>= the preregistered minimum of 20 splits), SB-corrected x2 to the 10-seed mean.

INSTRUMENT_GATE_SB_consistency.statistic: r1_S6 = mean pairwise single-seed Spearman over the C(6,2)=15 pairs of seeds 401-406 (computed from S=6 data ONLY); predicted_10 = 10*r1_S6 / (1 + 9*r1_S6); measured_10 = SB-corrected 5v5 ceiling on the S=10 data
INSTRUMENT_GATE_SB_consistency.gate: |predicted_10 - measured_10| <= 0.10 on BOTH focal targets C1 and C5
INSTRUMENT_GATE_SB_consistency.on_failure: STOP. Write phase4/PHASE4_DEFECT.md BEFORE any verdict is computed. P11 does not proceed at S=10.
INSTRUMENT_GATE_SB_consistency.expectation_not_a_result: from r1 ~ 0.75 (C1, phase2/results/p1_seed_ladder.json), SB predicts a 10-seed ceiling ~ 0.968; bar ~ 0.48. At n=24 masks the p<0.025 critical rho ~ 0.41, so bar and significance are commensurate — the test is LIVE, not foregone.

P12.FALLBACK_if_over_budget: seeds 407, 408 only -> S = 8 (48 retrains). The ceiling is then all 35 distinct 4v4 splits, SB x2, and P11's analysis seed count is 8. Named here so it is not a post-hoc choice.

P13.name: DIFFUSION SETTLEMENT — the follow-up PHASE3_REPORT §6.3 demands
P13.design: the SAME 24 Stage-G masks x 2 NEW diffusion seeds (607, 608), combined with the existing seeds 601-606 -> S = 8. Frozen config phase3/results/p10_config_frozen.json UNTOUCHED (lr 1e-3, 16000 steps, H=8, DDIM=5, eta=0, fixed latent seed 12345). Probe battery as P10b.

PREREGISTERED_AGGREGATOR.aggregator: MEDIAN over seeds of the held-out executed-action L2 per mask (neg_plain_loss)
PREREGISTERED_AGGREGATOR.why: the heavy-tail remedy. PHASE3_DEFECT.md: the diffusion policy is deterministic but NOT seed-stable; an occasional seed lands the fixed DDIM latent in the wrong basin and its L2 blows up 3-5x, so the seed MEAN is a broken estimator (4 of 9 mean ceilings NEGATIVE; SB consistency off by 0.61; reliability DROPS as seeds are added). The median restored ceilings to 0.57-0.77.
PREREGISTERED_AGGREGATOR.status: This aggregator is PREREGISTERED HERE, before any S=8 datum exists. In Phase 3 it was a POST-HOC diagnostic and was labelled as one.

ceiling.estimator: mean Spearman over ALL 35 distinct 4v4 seed split-halves of the 8 seeds, between the two half-MEDIAN outcome vectors across the 24 masks
ceiling.reported: BOTH the uncorrected 4v4 split-half value AND the SB-corrected (x2) value
ceiling.bar_uses: the SB-corrected value (the HIGHER, therefore conservative-for-passing, choice)
ceiling.caveat_stated_up_front: Spearman-Brown is exact for MEANS and only APPROXIMATE for medians. This is disclosed here, before the number exists, and is restated wherever the ceiling is reported.

UP_FRONT_CEILING_USABILITY_GATE.when: BEFORE any LDS is computed for that target
UP_FRONT_CEILING_USABILITY_GATE.sb_consistency_definition: r1_S4 = mean pairwise single-seed Spearman over the C(4,2)=6 pairs of the ORIGINAL preregistered seeds 601-604 (single-seed reliability is aggregator-free, so it is the correct SB base and it is exactly the statistic whose MEAN-side failure was reported in PHASE3_DEFECT.md §2); predicted_8 = 8*r1_S4 / (1 + 7*r1_S4); measured_8 = the SB-corrected 4v4 median ceiling on the S=8 data. Gate: |predicted_8 - measured_8| <= 0.15.
UP_FRONT_CEILING_USABILITY_GATE.on_failure: that target's verdict is INSTRUMENT-UNUSABLE — NOT a FAIL — and is stated as such. No LDS is reported as a verdict for it.
UP_FRONT_CEILING_USABILITY_GATE.also_reported_descriptively: the same SB check based on r1 over all C(8,2)=28 seed pairs

champion_estimator.ensemble: the EXISTING E=5 diffusion members dpens_s621..s625 (phase3/results/p10_influence_per_member.parquet)
champion_estimator.noise_bank: the FROZEN paired (t, epsilon) bank, phase3/results/p10_noise_bank.json — untouched
champion_estimator.aggregation: per-member scale normalization (unit L2) then MEAN over the 5 members
champion_estimator.justification_on_record: TracIn's split-half reliability across diffusion ensemble members is 0.927 at E=5 (p10_attr_stability.json) — the only attributor with consistent signal for this policy class.
champion_estimator.sweeps: NONE. No lambda, no hyperparameter, no alternative bank.

CRITERION.test: champion rho >= 0.5 * measured median SB-corrected ceiling AND one-sided p < 0.025 (Bonferroni-2)
CRITERION.gated_by: the up-front ceiling-usability gate, per target

PREREGISTERED_SYMMETRIC_INTERPRETATION.PASS_on_C1: demo-grain faithfulness is policy-class-dependent, and the BC null does not generalize.
PREREGISTERED_SYMMETRIC_INTERPRETATION.FAIL_on_both_with_usable_ceilings: the null extends to the diffusion class on this corpus — the external-validity question closes in the null direction.
PREREGISTERED_SYMMETRIC_INTERPRETATION.MIXED_one_usable_and_fail_one_unusable: report exactly that. NO averaging over verdict types.

C5_DIAGNOSIS.status: DESCRIPTIVE, EXPLORATORY-LABELLED. Never a verdict. Instrument characterization only.
C5_DIAGNOSIS.question: why did C5 carry no signal in the P10 median diagnostic (ratio 0.08)?
reported: C5's median-outcome distribution across the 24 masks
C5's mask-outcome spread (between-mask signal sd) vs C1's
C5's within-mask seed sd (noise) vs C1's, and the resulting S/N
the per-attributor scores (TracIn, TRAK, IF) on C5

P14.name: CONFIRMATORY HETEROGENEITY ON FRESH GROUND TRUTH
P14.rationale: Phase-3 P7 found C2 and C9 clear half-ceiling at some grains — DESCRIPTIVELY, on ground truth that had already been used for exploration. No confirmatory license. P14 confirms or kills it on ground truth NO analysis has ever touched.

fresh_mask_corpus.construction: IDENTICAL rule to src/masks.py:build_demo_masks — 68 of the 135 demos, within-cluster stratified (5 clusters contribute 8 demos, 4 contribute 7), balanced per-demo inclusion — with a NEW mask seed 1104 and K=16 (so each cluster is an 'eight' 8 or 9 times; 16*5 = 80 = 8*9 + 1*8).
fresh_mask_corpus.seed_provenance: NEW. Phase-1 used DEMO_MASK_SEED=11 for the 24 Stage-G masks; P8a used rng(909) to SELECT 12 of those 24. 1104 has never been used.
fresh_mask_corpus.MANDATORY_CHECK: verify ZERO of the 16 new masks coincides (as a set of demo ids) with ANY of the 24 Stage-G masks. If any coincides, the mask seed is incremented and the check re-run; the number of increments is reported.

P14.training: 16 masks x S=4 seeds (411, 412, 413, 414) = 64 BC retrains. Identical config/trainer.
P14.probes: restricted to C2's and C9's clusters ONLY: --clusters C2,C9 => 6 tasks x 10 rollouts = 60 episodes per model, plus held-out L2 for C2 and C9.

ceiling.estimator: all 3 distinct 2v2 seed split-halves of the 4 seeds, between the two half-MEAN outcome vectors across the 16 masks; SB-corrected x2 to the 4-seed mean
ceiling.aggregator: seed MEAN (BC; same justification as P11)

PRIMARY_TEST.estimator: the P11 champion, FROZEN IDENTICALLY (TracIn, E=20, per-member unit-L2 normalization). No re-selection, no per-cell choice.
PRIMARY_TEST.cells_provenance: these are C2's and C9's P7-QUALIFYING grains under P7's PRIMARY grouping rule (a) (phase3/results/p7_grain_ladder.csv). C9 also qualified at g=3; it is NOT included, because the prompt's four cells were fixed before this preregistration and adding a fifth would enlarge the family post-hoc.
PRIMARY_TEST.grouping_rule: P7's PRIMARY rule (a): random within cluster, default_rng(707), chunked into consecutive blocks of g — the SAME rule, the SAME seed, reused verbatim from phase3/src/p7_grain_ladder.py:groups_random.
PRIMARY_TEST.criterion: rho >= 0.5 * measured 4-seed SB-corrected ceiling AND one-sided p < 0.0125 (Bonferroni-4 across the four target x grain cells)

DISCLOSED_TENSION_IN_THE_PRIMARY_DESIGN.fact: P7's qualifying cells were qualified by a MAX OVER THREE ATTRIBUTORS. Read from phase3/results/p7_grain_ladder.csv (rule a): C2@g=1 qualified via TracIn (ratio 0.509); C2@g=3 qualified via **IF** (ratio 0.652) while TracIn there scored only 0.277; C9@g=1 via TracIn (0.516); C9@g=5 via TracIn (0.663).
DISCLOSED_TENSION_IN_THE_PRIMARY_DESIGN.consequence: freezing the primary estimator to the P11 champion (TracIn) makes C2@g=3 a GENUINELY ADVERSARIAL cell — prior evidence does not predict TracIn to pass it.
DISCLOSED_TENSION_IN_THE_PRIMARY_DESIGN.why_we_preregister_it_anyway: a per-cell attributor choice is exactly the multiple-comparison move Phase-3 P6.5 exposed and cross-validated away. The champion is frozen or it is not a champion.
DISCLOSED_TENSION_IN_THE_PRIMARY_DESIGN.remedy: a SECOND preregistered family (below), which gives the P7 heterogeneity its actual best shot at the price of a wider Bonferroni correction. Both families are declared HERE, before any Phase-4 number exists.

SECONDARY_TEST.estimator: per cell, the attributor that QUALIFIED that cell in P7 under rule (a) — frozen NOW from phase3/results/p7_grain_ladder.csv, not from any Phase-4 datum: C2@g=1 -> TracIn, C2@g=3 -> IF, C9@g=1 -> TracIn, C9@g=5 -> TracIn. Same E=20 ensemble, same per-member unit-L2 normalization.
SECONDARY_TEST.criterion: rho >= 0.5 * measured 4-seed SB-corrected ceiling AND one-sided p < 0.00625 (Bonferroni-8 across the two families x four cells)
SECONDARY_TEST.status: SECONDARY. The PRIMARY verdict is the champion's.

POWER_LIMIT_STATED_UP_FRONT.critical_rho_primary: at n=16 and one-sided alpha=0.0125 the critical rho is ~0.55; at alpha=0.00625 (secondary) it is ~0.59
POWER_LIMIT_STATED_UP_FRONT.bar_expectation: the half-ceiling bar will be ~0.45 (from an S=4 SB ceiling ~0.90), so SIGNIFICANCE binds, not the ratio
POWER_LIMIT_STATED_UP_FRONT.ASYMMETRY: this test is CONSERVATIVE. A FAIL here is WEAK evidence (small n, stiff critical rho); a PASS is STRONG. This asymmetry is stated UP FRONT and must be restated verbatim wherever the P14 verdict appears.

PREREGISTERED_INTERPRETATION.PASS_on_any_cell: the paper upgrades from 'attribution fails at demo grain' to 'attribution faithfulness is target-dependent, confirmed out-of-sample — and here is the moderator question that opens.'
PREREGISTERED_INTERPRETATION.FAIL_on_all: the P7 heterogeneity is flagged as likely exploration noise. (Qualified by the stated power limit: a FAIL at n=16 is weak evidence.)

OUT_OF_SCOPE_phase4_does_NOT: no lambda or hyperparameter sweeps (champions are frozen)
no re-litigation of any settled verdict
no improvised remedy beyond what a stage's preregistration names: if a preregistered gate fails, the stage REPORTS and STOPS

stages.note: attribution only: extend the Gram cache to members 211-220

BUDGET_LEDGER.per_stage_guard: >1.5x a stage line => phase4/BUDGET_ALERT.md, PAUSE, decide, document
CUT_ORDER: P12 seeds 4 -> 2 (S=8; the fallback named in P12)

REPORTING.verification: EVERY report number machine-verified into phase4/results/report_verification.json
required_sections: the three preregistered verdicts (P11, P13, P14), each with its preregistered interpretation sentence VERBATIM and its numbers
the P12/P13 instrument gates (SB-consistency checks) with pass/fail
